mahindra-scorpio-classic.author: RuatfelaChhangte
mahindra-scorpio-classic.alt: Mahindra Scorpio Classic in white, front three-quarter view
mahindra-scorpio-classic.note: Scorpio Classic (2022 on): twin-peaks logo on the vertical-slat chrome grille, Mizoram registration. An official district car with a small pennant; wheels may be non-standard. Original is 1466 px wide.

mahindra-scorpio-n.author: LuvsMG481
mahindra-scorpio-n.alt: Mahindra Scorpio-N Z8L in dark green, front three-quarter view
mahindra-scorpio-n.note: Australian-registered Scorpio (sold in India as Scorpio-N, Z8L trim); same body, grille and lamps as the Indian car.

mahindra-scorpio-n.author: LuvsMG481
mahindra-scorpio-n.alt: Mahindra Scorpio-N Z8L in dark green, rear three-quarter view
mahindra-scorpio-n.note: Australian-registered Scorpio (Scorpio-N in India, Z8L trim); exterior identical to the Indian car. Shot in shade, slightly dark.

mahindra-thar-roxx.author: The Drivers Hub
mahindra-thar-roxx.alt: Mahindra Thar Roxx in white, front three-quarter view
mahindra-thar-roxx.note: Five-door Thar Roxx (2024 on), Maharashtra registration: six-slot grille, C-shaped DRLs, rear-door handle in the C-pillar.

mahindra-thar-roxx.author: The Drivers Hub
mahindra-thar-roxx.alt: Mahindra Thar Roxx in white off-road on rocks, front three-quarter view
mahindra-thar-roxx.note: Same Indian-registered Thar Roxx as the first photo, wider shot. Second front view because no other angle is on Commons.

mahindra-xuv-3xo.author: LuvsMG481
mahindra-xuv-3xo.alt: Mahindra XUV 3XO AX7L in white with black roof, front three-quarter view
mahindra-xuv-3xo.note: Australian-registered XUV 3XO AX7L; the export car uses the Indian body, lamps and wheels unchanged (built in India).

mahindra-xuv-3xo.author: LuvsMG481
mahindra-xuv-3xo.alt: Mahindra XUV 3XO AX7L in white with black roof, rear three-quarter view
mahindra-xuv-3xo.note: Australian-registered XUV 3XO AX7L, identical to the India-built car; full-width tail-lamp bar and XUV 3XO lettering. Pedestrians in the background.

mahindra-xuv-3xo.author: Sreedit
mahindra-xuv-3xo.alt: Mahindra XUV 3XO in white, front three-quarter view
mahindra-xuv-3xo.note: Indian XUV 3XO photographed in India (2025): split C-shaped DRLs and twin-peaks grille. Second front view because no side or interior photo is on Commons.

mahindra-xuv400.alt: Mahindra XUV400 EL in white with copper accents, front three-quarter view
mahindra-xuv400.note: Indian XUV400 EL, Jharkhand green EV plate (blurred by the uploader). The 2024 Pro update changed the cabin, not the exterior.

mahindra-xuv400.author: Ank Kumar
mahindra-xuv400.alt: Mahindra XUV400 EL in white, rear three-quarter view
mahindra-xuv400.note: Same Indian XUV400 EL as the front photo: copper twin-peaks badge and XUV400 lettering; exterior unchanged by the 2024 Pro update.

mahindra-be-6.author: Cppfront

mahindra-be-6.note: Indian BE 6 on a Karnataka green EV plate (2025). The car is now sold as BE 6 Sporteq (renamed 2026, extra battery option). Thin ceremonial thread on the bonnet.

mahindra-be-6.author: Cppfront
mahindra-be-6.alt: Mahindra BE 6 in Firestorm Orange, rear view
mahindra-be-6.note: Same Karnataka-registered BE 6: full-width tail-lamp frame and BE 6 badge. Now sold as BE 6 Sporteq.

mahindra-xev-9e.author: Cppfront

mahindra-xev-9e.note: Indian XEV 9e on a Karnataka green EV plate (Bangalore, Aug 2025): coupe roofline, full-width light bar, INGLO wheels.
